investment_theses.thesis: Long BTC spot / short short-term DXY on May PCE softness (if headline <3.1% YoY), expecting Fed hold but market to price 2–3 rate cuts by Sept 2026.
investment_theses.horizon: 2–4 weeks (May 7 PCE print through June FOMC)
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Bitcoin stalling at $83–84k ahead of PCE print, indicating tight positioning before inflation catalyst.
CNBC: Fed inflation measure release Wednesday; market expects ongoing price pressures but consumer spending resilience suggests disinflation narrative may stick.
Cointelegraph: $3.1B Bitcoin ETF inflow streak vs. Ether fund outflows; BTC bulls defending key price level (inverse correlation to rate expectations).
investment_theses.counter_view: PCE headline accelerates >3.2% YoY, forcing Fed to hold into Q3 2026; stagflation narrative dominates, crushing risk assets and BTC.
investment_theses.expression: BTC perps long 5–10x leverage, 2-week horizon; simultaneously short 3x DXY short-dated calls; hedge with long gold spot.

investment_theses.thesis: Long Boeing (BA) and defense-adjacent names (LMT, RTX) on multi-year Navy contract, heightened geopolitical risk (Russia–Ukraine, Iran, Korea DMZ), and 2027 defense budget cycle acceleration.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Boeing just won U.S. Navy next-gen fighter jet deal; +3% move undershoots intrinsic value given multi-decade contract durability.
Reuters/CNBC: Russia intensifies data center attacks on Ukraine; NATO condemns nuclear rhetoric; this escalation sustains DoD spending momentum.
BBC: South Korea–North Korea DMZ incident; Trump admin geopolitical posture favors defense spending.
investment_theses.counter_view: Unexpected ceasefire or de-escalation (Iran sanctions relief, Ukraine deal) crushes defense momentum; BA also faces commercial aviation headwinds (737 MAX production delays, supply chain).
investment_theses.expression: Long BA equity 60% / ITA (aerospace ETF) 40%; establish position over next 2 weeks, trim on 15–20% gainers into August recess.

investment_theses.thesis: Long Novo Nordisk (NVO) on Wegovy oral formulation real-world durability and TAM expansion; position ahead of Q2 earnings and Phase 4 trial readouts (July–September 2026).
supporting_signals: CNBC: Wegovy pill real-world study shows sustained weight loss without weekly injections; oral formulation is a $10B+ TAM unlock (broader patient compliance, insurance coverage).
Sector momentum: Eli Lilly GLP-1 competition heating up; obesity drug category remains in early adoption phase (penetration <5% eligible U.S. population).
investment_theses.counter_view: Wegovy pill shows lower efficacy than injections in subsequent trials; Eli Lilly outcompetes on cost or efficacy; insurance formulary access remains bottleneck.
investment_theses.expression: Long NVO shares 100–150 shares per $100k dry powder; target entry on any 8–12% drawdowns; sell into +20% moves post-earnings.

investment_theses.thesis: Long USDC / other stablecoin demand via long USDC yield (3–5% on lending platforms) and short USDT (Tether concentration risk) as AllUnity USDAU and institutional adoption accelerate supply growth.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: AllUnity launches USDAU (European stablecoin); Kalshi funding at $40B valuation signals institutional/retail growth inflection.
Stablecoin supply dashboard: USDT dominance declining; USDC/USDC+ adoption by RWA platforms and corporate treasuries accelerating (e.g., Blackrock iShares tokenization track record).
investment_theses.counter_view: Regulatory crackdown on stablecoins (MiCA enforcement in EU, U.S. legislation); USDT Tether proves resilient; yield compression on lending platforms as supply grows.
investment_theses.expression: Long $100–200k USDC on Aave/Compound at 4%+ APY; short USDT basis (long USDC, short USDT on leverage) via perp spreads; 6-month horizon.

supporting_signals: Cointelegraph: Bitcoin ETF $3.1B inflow streak; Ether funds turning red (outflow pressure).
CoinDesk: Lighter (LIT) trading volatility spike on Robinhood perps plan suggests retail ETH churn; NEAR, PENGU trending but not enough to prop Ethereum narrative.
